behavior: Before readiness only, the native helper may emit one closed startup-failure frame tied to the original request ID. Nine fixed stages distinguish request/environment, executable attributes/open/hash, Job creation/configuration, self birth and readiness output.
Only failed Job creation/configuration APIs attach their immediate Win32 numeric code. Other stages have no native code. No raw errors, source paths, URLs, credentials or output are included.

The host retains refusal and RUNTIME_STOP_UNCONFIRMED, invokes no readiness callback for this frame, and ignores further output after failure. A failure frame cannot acknowledge execution, verify exit, grant rights or retire uncertain resources.
The CI owner projects only the validated fixed phase through its existing bounded field. All original owner/token/Job/identity/cleanup checks remain.
nativeAcceptance: Pending. The prior 6f2097b proof identifies the guardian boundary but not which managed startup operation fails.
